sentences.en: The butcher who sold me this beef is always friendly.
sentences.zh: 卖给我这块牛肉的那个屠夫总是很友好。

sentences.en: For kosher meat, I go to a butcher I trust.
sentences.zh: 为了买到犹太教饮食法许可的肉，我会去一个我信任的屠夫那里。

sentences.en: The differences in quality between the two butchers was amazing.
sentences.zh: 这两个屠夫之间的质量差异令人惊讶。

senses.zh: 屠夫，屠杀者，刽子手，肉商，小贩
屠宰，滥杀，将某事弄得一团糟
